entries.name: Palm tree
entries.style: low-poly, flat colours, curved segmented trunk under a crown of faceted fronds (Quaternius 2019)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: The plan's source (a Quaternius static palm tree on poly.pizza) is behind a Cloudflare challenge; this is PalmTree_1 from Quaternius's Ultimate Nature Pack on OpenGameArt (License.txt in the zip: CC0 1.0), the same zip as the tree, tree-pine, tree-autumn and bush entries, so they read as one set. Of the four palms in the pack it has the fullest crown (more than a dozen fronds, 5.2 x 4.7 m) on the classic S-curved coconut-palm trunk; PalmTree_3 is straighter and thinner-crowned, PalmTree_4 has only eight fronds, and PalmTree_2 leans so far that its base sits 3.5 m off the crown's centre. The fronds are closed shells (a doubleSided render was identical), so they are not double-sided. Its Coconuts material is buried in the crown and never shows, so it maps to trunk. Height 8 m: a coconut palm on a beach or resort promenade is 6-10 m when young to mid-age (old ones reach 20-30 m); at 8 m the fronds spring from about 7 m and droop to 5.5 m, high over a 1.6 m person, as in an anime beach or island background. Colours on noon (no green), as the broadleaf tree: fronds vermilion (accent) shading to iris, so the palm sits with the other trees as the same foliage; the trunk is pale skin-tan shading to iris, a light, distinct trunk against the near-black trunk of the broadleaf tree and the vermilion trunk of the pine. Static: no clips.
